license.conflictingUpstreamClaim: README.md states PostgreSQL license while LICENSE.txt contains the MIT permission grant.
license.disposition: Preserve both claims; retain the exact LICENSE.txt bytes with every redistributed fixture and do not infer broader rights.

criteria: immutable upstream revision and local checksums
cross-platform PostgreSQL runtime already exercised in CI
relationships, functions, triggers, views, partitions, constraints and nontrivial data
small enough for deterministic local and CI qualification
useful discovery pressure without production credentials or personal data

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Richer enterprise estate, but SQL Server runtime and ARM64 portability add infrastructure before the adapter contract exists.
Strong multi-schema and PL/SQL pressure, but executable Oracle runtime and redistribution boundaries are heavier than the first fixture needs.
Apache-2.0 and healthcare-relevant, but it primarily generates exchange records rather than an ugly relational source estate.
Excellent later CDC pressure, but Kafka/container topology would conflate fixture selection with P6-DISC-08 runtime work.

limitations: Community sample rather than a production legacy estate.
No access-denial, misleading-documentation, hidden-consumer or CDC mutation cases are planted yet.
DVD-rental semantics do not establish healthcare-domain correctness.
PostgreSQL portability does not validate SQL Server, Oracle or cloud-source behavior.
